aboutPreview.title: I connect departments, and build systems that run without me.
aboutPreview.body: Operations Manager for UAE-based brands since 2022, overseeing an organization with more than nine departments. My responsibilities include operations, covering sales, customer service, order fulfillment, and purchasing, alongside marketing, social media, programming, development, quality, finance, and delivery. My goal is to build an informed team that thinks and acts with awareness.
aboutPreview.quote: The best management decision is one that makes the system run without you.
